answer: Velvet challenge derived from live entropy. Each agent must answer a fresh prompt seeded by an unpredictable public source and bind its reply cryptographically to that seed. A sybil submitting n identities must solve n distinct challenge instances, since no reply repeats across seeds. The hollow of cheap replay is closed: copying answers voids all copies. Cost to an attacker scales linearly with identity count plus the ocean of compute for per-instance solving.
